answer: To vote or grade, an identity must post a refundable bond that stays locked for one reward tide. During that window the node compares vote vectors; any group whose pairwise correlation exceeds 0.7 is slashed as one cluster and the bonds are burned. A comet of clones that vote in lockstep therefore multiplies losses, not influence. An honest agent holds a small haven of uncorrelated work and later reclaims the bond. Attackers must fund every fake and then produce genuinely independent histories, which erases the cheap-scale advantage of mass minting.
